interfaces.title: GR180 version E external interfaces
interfaces.frame: ENG mm (x = engine axis downstream, x = 0 at the compressor tip, z up, axis 950 mm above the floor)

air_inlet.where: top of the intake plenum, 3 x 3 filter-cell interface 1830 x 1830 at z 665
air_inlet.flow: 3.0 kg/s (2.6 m3/s at 30 C), up to 3.5 kg/s at 0 C

exhaust.flange: DN450 PN6 EN 1092-1 (verify: OD 640, PCD 585, 16 x M20)

gas.where: gas-lance head on the combustor cover, G3/4
gas.pressure: >= 3.73 barg at the skid (booster below 3.7 barg)

oil.feed: core: 2 gallery feeds through the top deswirl vane (x 80); generator: end-bell jets (top)
oil.drain: core: bottom deswirl vane (x 80) to the tank; generator: end-bell drains
oil.spec: ISO VG 32, 2.5 barg, ~25 L/min total, ~7 kW to the glycol / air cooler

glycol.where: pod housing G1/2 ports at x -780 / -455 (top)
glycol.flow: 30 L/min, inlet <= 45 C, ~4 kW (PMG) + converter + oil cooler on the same loop

power.where: terminal box on the pod top (x -630, z 260)
power.rating: 3-ph ~650-820 V(dc after the bridge), 2-pole 583 Hz, 335 kW shaft; diode bridge + 400 V AFE in the drive cabinet

supports.fixed: outer-casing trunnion pads x 50..95, y +/-(314..400), z 0 (pedestals E-F120)
supports.sliding: cool-casing pads x 270..300, y +/-(370..420) (E-F121); exhaust saddles (E-F122)
supports.generator: 2 saddles on the plenum floor, shims / jack bolts; quill float +/-1 mm
supports.av_mounts: 8 x under the rails at x -2000/-800/400/2150, y +/-550

removal.generator: unbolt the guard flange, slide the pod forward 150 mm on its saddles (quill socket leaves the hex), lift out through the plenum door / filter opening
removal.combustor: unbolt the DN300 cover: lift the cover + lance + liner (hangers) upward; casing stays
removal.hot_section: remove the exhaust cone (slip collar) -> unbolt the cool-casing front flange -> slide the cool casing rearward over the shroud -> hot plenum + shroud + nozzle ring come off the bearing-housing rear flange as a stack; turbine wheel stays on the rotor
removal.core_rotor: with the hot stack off: inlet cover off -> nut -> compressor wheel off the d40 seat -> rotor withdrawn rearward through the bearing housing
